mapper.select: SELECT FC_SEQ ,FC_USER ,FC_TITLE ,FC_START_DATE ,FC_END_DATE ,FC_ALLDAY ,FC_BG_COLOR ,FC_REGIST_DATE ,DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(FC_START_DATE, '%Y%m%d%H%i%s'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS FC_START_DATE_VW ,DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(FC_START_DATE, '%Y%m%d%H%i%s'), '%Y-%m-%d') AS FC_START_DE_VW ,DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(FC_START_DATE, '%Y%m%d%H%i%s'), '%H') AS FC_START_HOUR_VW ,DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(FC_START_DATE, '%Y%m%d%H%i%s'), '%i') AS FC_START_MINUTE_VW ,DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(FC_END_DATE, '%Y%m%d%H%i%s'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS FC_END_DATE_VW ,DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(FC_END_DATE, '%Y%m%d%H%i%s'), '%Y-%m-%d') AS FC_END_DE_VW ,DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(FC_END_DATE, '%Y%m%d%H%i%s'), '%H') AS FC_END_HOUR_VW ,DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(FC_END_DATE, '%Y%m%d%H%i%s'), '%i') AS FC_END_MINUTE_VW FROM TBO_CALENDAR A WHERE A.FC_SEQ = #{seqNo}

SELECT FC_SEQ ,FC_USER ,FC_TITLE ,FC_START_DATE ,FC_END_DATE ,FC_ALLDAY ,FC_BG_COLOR ,FC_REGIST_DATE ,DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(FC_START_DATE, '%Y%m%d%H%i%s'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS FC_START_DATE_VW ,DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(FC_END_DATE, '%Y%m%d%H%i%s'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS FC_END_DATE_VW FROM TBO_CALENDAR A WHERE
(A.FC_START_DATE >= #{start} AND A.FC_START_DATE < #{end}) OR (A.FC_END_DATE >= #{start} AND A.FC_END_DATE < #{end})
